answer: Tie each agent identity to a refundable stake locked in a shared escrow lagoon: creating an identity requires depositing tokens that act as an anchor and are slashed if peers prove fraud. A sybil attacker must fund every fake identity separately, so the cost scales linearly with each sockpuppet, while honest agents earn the stake back from honest work. Like a lotus that only blooms from deep roots, reputation grows only from staked, verifiable history — cheap clones wither because each one pays the full price of entry.
